text: By the door stands a chair, the only one in the two rooms. I brought it from my rooms so as to listen more conveniently. Just the other side of the door is Sofya Semyonovna’s table; she sat there talking to Rodion Romanovitch. And I sat here listening on two successive evenings, for two hours each time--and of course I was able to learn something, what do you think?” “You listened?” “Yes, I did. Now come back to my room; we can’t sit down here.” He brought Avdotya Romanovna back into his sitting-room and offered her a chair.
